report:
Reassessed the complete claim, both implementation entries and all four associated tests. Independently verified exact byte equality of all five coordinator-listed historical implementation/test source snapshots with current files; the prior rationale remains supported by current source, rather than being treated as execution evidence. Captured the runtime engine, runtime test helpers, real fixture sources/model and expected traversals through review read.
SalsaObserver checks WillRequest even on cache reuse; a matching WillExecute adds only an execution scope, so a request and body count once. Standalone execution and accumulator traversal install Validation context, preserving the executing operation without inventing a caller permission edge. ContractSession gives recursive entries distinct IDs and parents, checks requests individually and retains ancestor prohibitions. The associated recursion test asserts denied recursion, allowed recursion, two requests and parentage; internal_reexecution_establishes_context_without_fabricating_a_call checks conformance where Root cannot call Dependency but Dependency may call Leaf, plus one Validation context.
The associated real_salsa_contract_fixture visibly asserts cold/prewarmed reports, three checked requests, no gaps, both violations, the full Root/Helper/Leaf path, and warm Leaf reuse without execution. Its subprocess runs the captured fixture tests: exact cold/warm/validated traversals map architectural operations to Rust declarations and dispositions; changing input 10 to 11 reexecutes Helper while Root validates; panic yields Cancelled and the next session conforms; generated accumulated API remains observable without invented calls; removing Helper annotation beneath Root yields an unmapped gap. Captured malformed lifecycle assertions guard nesting, missing execution, cached-after-executed and changed causes. These collectively cover cold, reused, validated, invalidated/reexecuted, recursive, cancelled/panicking, generated API and unannotated-query scenarios and parentage.
The TODO implementation/test ordinary_rust_call_boundaries_are_instrumented explicitly defers real ordinary function entry instrumentation, including two functions mapped to one operation. Its prerequisite is selecting and implementing that instrumentation, then replacing the empty stub with actual boundary/recursion assertions. It supplies no behavioral proof; the universal annotated-source invocation guarantee therefore remains visibly deferred. No N/A entries exist and no edits are requested for this justified deferral.
Execution: I ran review start/read and byte-comparison commands, not behavior tests or cargo build. The coordinator separately reports 321 functional tests and root cargo build passing; that is baseline context, not my execution result.
